text: Bitcoin is essentially flat while Ethereum and smaller caps are showing modest gains, suggesting traders are rotating away from the largest asset despite its market dominance holding steady at 58.4%. Extreme Fear sentiment (12/100) paired with declining 7-day momentum indicates capitulation selling, though the $75B in daily volume—solid but not panicked liquidation levels—suggests the selloff is controlled rather than cascading. This setup typically precedes stabilization or mild recoveries once fear exhaustion hits.
